sections.title: Pricing FAQs

items.question: Do I need PriceM8 Core to use estimating packs?
items.answer:
Yes.
PriceM8 Core is the foundation of the platform and is required for all estimating packs.
Core includes scheduling, client portal, file storage, and branded PDF quotes & invoices. Estimating packs add trade-specific tasks, materials and calculation logic on top of this foundation.

items.question: What do estimating packs actually unlock?
items.answer:
Estimating packs unlock:
- ready-made trade tasks
- built-in labour roles & logic
- material quantity calculations
- consistent pricing structures
Instead of building everything manually, you start with proven setups designed for real jobs.

items.question: Can I use PriceM8 without any estimating packs?
items.answer:
Yes.
You can use PriceM8 Core on its own to:
- create and send professional quotes & invoices
- manage jobs and schedules
- communicate with clients via the portal
- store files and photos per project
Estimating packs are optional, but they’re where PriceM8 really saves time and prevents underpricing.

items.question: What’s included in the Builder All-In Plan?
items.answer:
The Builder All-In Plan includes:
- PriceM8 Core
- General Building – 1st Fix
- Landscaping Pack
- General Building – 2nd Fix
- Plumbing Estimator
- Electrical Estimator
It’s the best value option if you regularly quote across multiple trades.

items.question: Why are some packs more expensive than others?
items.answer:
Pricing reflects scope and complexity.
For example:
- 1st Fix and Landscaping packs include complex material and labour logic
- Plumbing and Electrical packs are narrower but still highly useful
You only pay for what you actually need.

items.question: Is the Garden Rooms pack really a one-time purchase?
items.answer:
Yes.
The Garden Rooms pack is a specialist estimator and is charged once.
There’s no ongoing subscription for it.
It’s designed for high-value projects and replaces spreadsheets or manual calculations entirely.

items.question: Is this pricing permanent?
items.answer:
No.
These are introductory launch prices for early PriceM8 users.
As new trades, features and automations are added, prices will increase.
Early users will always get the best value.

items.question: Can I change or cancel my plan later?
items.answer:
Yes.
You can:
- add or remove estimating packs at any time
- upgrade to bundles when it makes sense
- cancel your subscription with no long-term contract
No lock-ins, no awkward calls.

items.question: How does this compare to tools like Tradify or PriceBuilder?
items.answer:
Most estimating tools give you a blank system and expect you to build everything yourself.
PriceM8 is different:
- ready-made trade packs
- built-in material logic
- labour-aware calculations
- smart scheduling linked to estimates
You spend less time setting things up and more time pricing jobs properly.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.answer:
Yes.
You can start a free trial and explore PriceM8 before committing.
No pressure — see how it fits your workflow first.

items.question: Who is PriceM8 best suited for?
items.answer:
PriceM8 is built for:
- builders
- landscapers
- garden room installers
- multi-trade contractors
If you price jobs regularly and want consistency, speed and confidence — this is for you.
